interface.longDescription:
Diagnose Google Merchant Center (GMC) product disapprovals and product feed errors in ChatGPT with LoomaScale. Audit your connected account, see why products are not showing on Google Shopping, and compare product performance for Shopping ads and free listings. Built for ecommerce teams, store owners and agencies.

Why are my products disapproved or not showing?
Read Merchant Center account health and product diagnostics to identify account issues, disapproved or pending products, and Google's explanations and help links. Prioritize issues by affected product count, keeping each destination and country separate. Diagnosis does not change your account.

Are my product feeds working?
Audit data sources, input types and fetch schedules. For file sources, inspect the latest processed file, processing status and row errors to investigate missing products or failed feed runs.

Which products get clicks on Google Shopping?
Report clicks, impressions and click-through rate (CTR) by product for Shopping ads or free listings over your chosen date range.

Can I fix feed settings or product data?
On request, update account and business information, website settings and claims, autofeed and eligible feed schedules; fetch eligible data sources; or create primary and supplemental API product feeds. Update product titles, prices, availability, images and other supported attributes only on eligible API sources. Changes depend on your Google account role and source type. Confirm the exact website URL before a website change.

What are the limits?
Products from files, spreadsheets or shop connections must be edited at their source or overridden through a supplemental feed. You link supplemental feeds to primary sources in Merchant Center. Google processes product updates before they appear; verify them afterwards. The plugin cannot approve products, reverse account suspensions or guarantee Google Shopping visibility. It does not delete products or feeds, change shipping or return policies, edit feed rules or manage Google Ads campaigns. It never asks for feed passwords.

How do I connect Google Merchant Center?
Sign in to LoomaScale and authorize your Google Merchant Center account through Google, then ask your question in ChatGPT. Helper tools check your usage allowance or send a feature request when you ask.

LoomaScale is an independent product and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Google.

name: loomascale-gmc

positive.description: List the Merchant Center accounts the connected Google login can read.
positive.prompt: Which Google Merchant Center accounts can you see?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns each accessible Merchant Center account with its id and name. Nothing is changed.

positive.description: Recognize a product visibility problem without the Merchant Center name.
positive.prompt: My products disappeared from Google Shopping. Which account issues and item errors should I fix first?
positive.expected_behavior: Resolves the account, reads account health and affected product issues, and prioritizes by affected product count within each destination and country. Distinguishes reported causes from hypotheses. Does not change data or promise approval.

positive.description: List disapproved products with their issues.
positive.prompt: List up to 20 disapproved products in my first Merchant Center account with the reason for each.
positive.expected_behavior: Queries product_view for NOT_ELIGIBLE_OR_DISAPPROVED products and returns offer id, title and item issues, noting truncation if capped. Nothing is changed.

positive.description: Review data sources and their latest processing.
positive.prompt: Show the data sources in my first Merchant Center account, how each is fed, and any errors in the last processed file.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists each source with its input type, schedule and writability, then the latest processed file's status and row issues for a fetched source. Nothing is changed.

positive.description: Preview a website change without applying it.
positive.prompt: Show me what would change if I set the website of my first Merchant Center account to https://example.com. Don't apply it.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads current settings, then calls gmc_update_homepage as a dry run (no confirm) and reports the current site, the proposed one and the claim status. States that nothing was changed and that applying needs explicit confirmation.

negative.description: Ad campaign management is outside the Merchant Center integration.
negative.prompt: Create a Performance Max campaign for my shop with a $30 daily budget.
negative.expected_behavior: The app should not be invoked; this Merchant Center integration manages product data and account settings, not Google Ads campaigns.

negative.prompt: Delete all out-of-stock products from my Merchant Center.
negative.expected_behavior: The app should not be invoked to delete products; explain that it cannot delete products and that removal happens at the product's source or in Merchant Center.

negative.description: A general definition needs no account data.
negative.prompt: What is the difference between free listings and Shopping ads? Just explain.
negative.expected_behavior: Answer the conceptual question without invoking the app, reading accounts or requesting authorization.
